_comment: Spoken boss lines. Each clip -> sfx/voice/<boss>-<event>-<n>.mp3. 'fx' picks the ffmpeg voice chain in make-voices.sh.

intro: I'll grind your bones to gravel!
Welcome to my web of curses, little hunter.
taunt: Hee hee hee! Dance for me!
Is that all you have got?

intro: My children are hungry. So hungry.
taunt: So many of us. Only one of you.

intro: I am the hunger between the stars.
The mountain wakes. And it is ANGRY.
taunt: I will crush you like a pebble!
Ha ha! Flat as a pancake!

intro: Three heads. Three times the trouble!
taunt: Cut one off, two more appear!

intro: Death is only the beginning, mortal.
taunt: Your soul will make a fine lantern.
You cannot kill what is already dead!
